test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If the diameter of a hemisphere is 21 cm , then the curved surface area (in cm²) of the hemisphere is: Take pi=(22)/(7)
solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of the hemisphere = 21 cm

Radius (r) = Diameter / 2 = 21 / 2 = 10.5 cm

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a hemisphere = 2πr²

**Calculation:**

Radius (r) = 10.5 cm

π = 22 / 7

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2 × π × r²

CSA = 2 × (22 / 7) × (10.5)²

CSA = 2 × (22 / 7) × 110.25

CSA = 2 × 22 × 15.75

CSA = 693 cm²

**The correct answer is option 4: 693 cm².**
